title: Zhinao Capsule Improved Sleep and Memory Disorders in APP/PS1 Mice via cAMP/PKA/CREB Signaling Pathway Modulation.
authors: Xi, Hu; Xie, Wenting; Yang, Yue; Li, Xiang; Zhai, Shu; Fang, Shuzhen; Yang, Yulong; Rao, Zhihong; Yang, Wenming; Li, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药智脑胶囊通过cAMP/PKA/CREB通路改善APP/PS1小鼠睡眠与记忆障碍，虽含分子对接但核心为药效与信号通路实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy and therapeutic mechanism of Zhinao Capsule (ZNC) in alleviating memory impairment and sleep disorders through an integrated approach involving network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation with molecular biological techniques. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Fifty APP/PS1 mice were randomly divided into five groups: donepezil hydrochloride tablets group (administered with Donepezil hydrochloride tablets (0.65 mg/(kg.d)), ZNC low-, medium-, and, high-dose groups (0.234/0.468/0.936 g/(kg.d)), the model and normal groups treated with 0.9% saline at a dose of 10 mL/(kg.d). Gavage was performed once daily for 28 consecutive days after acclimatization, feeding, and grouping. Behavioral, Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E), and Immunohistochemistry (IHC) analyses were used to verify the in vivo efficacy of ZNC in APP/PS1 mice. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to predict the potential molecular mechanisms of ZNC in alleviating Alzheimer's Disease (AD) and related sleep disorders. Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA), Quantitative Real-Time Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-qPCR), and Western Blot (WB) analyses were used to establish whether ZNC modulated relevant pathways to exert therapeutic effects against AD-related sleep disorders. RESULTS: PiezoSleep monitoring, Morris Water Maze (MWM), H&E, and IHC tests revealed that ZNC could restore impaired learning memory and sleep structures, improve the cellular morphology of neurons in the hippocampal CA1 and CA3 regions, promote neurogenesis, and increase synaptic plasticity. That neuroinflammation and the Cyclic Adenosine Monophosphate (cAMP)/Protein Kinase A (PKA)/ cAMP Response Element Binding Protein (CREB) signaling pathway were ZNC's key avenues in alleviating AD-related sleep disorders. On the other hand, the IHC, WB, ELISA, and RT-qPCR tests confirmed that ZNC significantly upregulated Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor (BDNF), cAMP, PKA mRNA, CREB mRNA, p-PKA, p-CREB, Synaptophysin (SYN), and Postsynaptic Density Protein 95 (PSD-95), significantly downregulated Amyloid Beta 1-42 (Abeta1-42) and inflammatory factors such as Glial Fibrillary Acidic Protein (GFAP), Interleukin-6 (IL6), IL-1beta, and Tumor Necrosis Factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), and upregulated neurotransmitters such as 5-Hydroxyindole-3-Acetic Acid (5-HIAA), 5-Hydroxy Tryptamine (5-HT), and Gamma-Aminobutyric Acid (GABA)(p<0.01, p<0.05). CONCLUSION: The present results show that ZNC can improve sleep and memory disorders in APP/PS1 mice via modulating the cAMP/PKA/CREB signaling pathway, attenuating Abeta and neuroinflammation, and improving synaptic plasticity.
abstract_zh: 目的：通过网络药理学、分子对接及分子生物学技术实验验证的综合方法，评估智脑胶囊（ZNC）缓解记忆障碍和睡眠障碍的功效及治疗机制。材料与方法：将50只APP/PS1小鼠随机分为五组：盐酸多奈哌齐片组（给予盐酸多奈哌齐片（0.65 mg/(kg.d)））、ZNC低、中、高剂量组（0.234/0.468/0.936 g/(kg.d)），模型组和正常组给予0.9%生理盐水，剂量为10 mL/(kg.d)。适应、喂养和分组后，连续灌胃28天，每日一次。采用行为学、苏木精-伊红染色（H&E）和免疫组织化学（IHC）分析验证ZNC在APP/PS1小鼠体内的功效。通过网络药理学和分子对接预测ZNC缓解阿尔茨海默病（AD）及相关睡眠障碍的潜在分子机制。采用酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）、实时荧光定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）和蛋白质印迹（WB）分析确定ZNC是否调节相关通路以发挥对AD相关睡眠障碍的治疗作用。结果：PiezoSleep监测、Morris水迷宫（MWM）、H&E和IHC测试显示，ZNC能恢复受损的学习记忆和睡眠结构，改善海马CA1和CA3区域神经元的细胞形态，促进神经发生，并增加突触可塑性。神经炎症和环磷酸腺苷（cAMP）/蛋白激酶A（PKA）/cAMP反应元件结合蛋白（CREB）信号通路是ZNC缓解AD相关睡眠障碍的关键途径。另一方面，IHC、WB、ELISA和RT-qPCR测试证实，ZNC显著上调脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）、cAMP、PKA mRNA、CREB mRNA、p-PKA、p-CREB、突触素（SYN）和突触后密度蛋白95（PSD-95），显著下调淀粉样蛋白β1-42（Abeta1-42）及炎症因子如胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）、白细胞介素-6（IL6）、IL-1beta和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha），并上调神经递质如5-羟基吲哚乙酸（5-HIAA）、5-羟色胺（5-HT）和γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）（p<0.01，p<0.05）。结论：目前的结果表明，ZNC可通过调节cAMP/PKA/CREB信号通路、减轻Abeta和神经炎症以及改善突触可塑性，改善APP/PS1小鼠的睡眠和记忆障碍。
